reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 121-130 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 21 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot (/tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip, SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) was read after dropping every column containing 'cmax'. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex and application/population/funbound comments only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from the original tables. Some PubMed abstracts print Cmax alongside the mapping fields (andrographolide, fluorouracil, ensartinib); in each case mapping was fixed by AUC/t1/2/n. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: the current PMDA amosulalol IF (the manifest IF URL is 404; the replacement 171911_2149018F1021_2_003_1F.pdf was found via the PMDA GeneralList), the PMDA pemafibrate review report A100 and CTD 2.7.6 K101, PMC7002734 (eperisone), and the PMC1386312 scanned PDF (nedocromil, via headless browser). Closed originals were time-boxed to abstracts: Panossian 2000 (andrographolide), de Haas 2009 (SL65.1498), Krishnaiah 2003 (5-FU), Zhou 2020 (ensartinib; Springer landing page + CT.gov NCT03804541 without results), Pellegatti 2009 (casopitant; DMD 403/Cloudflare), Grases 2001 (phytate). IR is not inferred from route: conventional tablets not worded IR are verified_with_caveat, following the 81-120 convention. Transient headless-browser files (gitignored .playwright-mcp/ and one temporary base64 dump in the repo root) were deleted, and no tracked or pre-existing repository file was changed. Disclosure: the Unpaywall API, used to check OA status for 6 DOIs, was called with the user's email as its required 'email' contact parameter. This should not have been done without asking; nothing else was sent.
unresolved_issues: Amosulalol (495): the manifest PMDA IF URL (…_1_LWT_2F.pdf) is dead (404). Values were read from the current IF (…_2_003_1F.pdf, PDF pp.23-24), whose page numbers are shifted by +2. The single-dose dosage form (Nakashima 1984, closed) is unstated, and the 12.5 and 25 mg groups are n=2 with no dispersion.
Eperisone (429): frdb_980 is an osmotic controlled-release tablet (ineligible). frdb_979's ± statistic is undefined, and FRDB's AUC 20.88 appears to be AUC0-t rather than AUC0-inf.
Andrographolide (21634): the dosed product is the Kan Jang fixed-combination herbal tablet (ineligible). The FRDB t1/2 3.94 h also disagrees with the abstract's 6.6 h.

Pemafibrate (9770): frdb_9426 and frdb_9430 are age/BMI-matched normal-organ-function controls in hepatic/renal impairment studies, not classic healthy-volunteer panels. Arithmetic means are recorded to match FRDB AUC/t1/2; geometric means are also given.
Nedocromil (2454): the dose is weight-based (1 mg/kg disodium salt; mean 70.5 mg), and oral F is 2-3% with flip-flop kinetics.
X-396/ensartinib (45290): verified from the abstract only (paywall). The form is a radiolabelled oral suspension and the statistic is unspecified.

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: 10.1177/0269881108092595 (SL65.1498), 10.1016/s0928-0987(03)00139-8 (5-FU fasting status), 10.1124/dmd.109.026781 (casopitant), 10.1002/biof.5520150105 (phytate), 10.1038/clpt.1984.201 (amosulalol formulation), 10.1007/s00280-020-04159-0 (ensartinib table).
Fytic acid (4904): an endogenous/dietary analyte given as a supplement product. Likely ineligible pending the full text.
Privacy disclosure: the user's email was sent to api.unpaywall.org as the contact parameter for 6 OA lookups; flag to the user.

arms.reason: Ahmed et al., Sci Rep 2020 (PMC7002734), reference arm A. The marketed IR eperisone tablets (Smur 50 mg × 3 = 150 mg) were given after an overnight fast of at least 10 h to 12 healthy men. Parent plasma Cmax by LC-ESI-MS/MS is 7.65 ± 1.28 ng/mL (range 5.80-9.95). Mapped by t1/2 1.81 h and AUC 20.88 ng·h/mL. Caveats: the ± statistic (SD vs SE) is not defined in the text, and FRDB labels AUC 20.88 as AUC0-inf although the paper appears to report it as AUC0-t (AUC0-inf 22.67).

arms.reason: Panossian et al., Phytomedicine 2000 (PMID 11081986). Humans received 4 tablets of Kan Jang, the Andrographis paniculata fixed combination (a multi-ingredient herbal product; Kan Jang also contains Eleutherococcus senticosus extract), equal to 20 mg andrographolide. The dosed product is a multi-ingredient herbal extract, not a single-entity parent drug, so the arm is ineligible. Also, the abstract t1/2 of 6.6 h does not match the FRDB t1/2 of 3.94 h, so the mapping is uncertain. The abstract's Cmax (~393 ng/mL) was not adopted.

arms.reason: Krishnaiah et al., Eur J Pharm Sci 2003 (PMID 12907286). The abstract confirms that 12 healthy volunteers received 50 mg 5-fluorouracil as an immediate-release tablet (the comparator to the guar-gum colon-targeted tablet), with plasma measurement. The IR tablet Cmax is 278 ± 21 ng/mL at Tmax 0.6 h, and AUC0-inf 205 matches FRDB. Fasting status and the ± statistic are not stated in the abstract, and the full text (Elsevier) is closed. The arm stays unverified on fasting, like the dimemorfan precedent.

arms.reason: Zhou et al., Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2020 (PMID 33044566; NCT03804541), a [14C]ensartinib (X-396) mass-balance study. The abstract states that 6 healthy men received a single 200 mg/100 μCi oral suspension fasted, with plasma ensartinib by LC-MS/MS. Mean Cmax is 185 ng/mL; AUC0-inf 3827 and t1/2 18.3 h match FRDB. Caveats: only the abstract and Springer landing page were readable (paywall), so there is no table locator and the statistic (arithmetic vs geometric) is undefined. The form is a radiolabelled oral suspension, not a marketed IR product, and the salt basis of the 200 mg dose is unconfirmed.

The abstract describes 7 healthy volunteers on an IP6-poor diet given single IP6 doses from three commercial sources at different doses, with plasma peaks at 4 h. IP6 (phytate) is an endogenous/dietary compound with a measurable baseline (0.07 mg/L on the poor diet), and the products are dietary supplements of unconfirmed salt form (e.g. Ca/Mg phytin or sodium phytate). The 1400 mg dose, the product, fasting status, baseline correction and Cmax cannot be confirmed without the full text (Wiley, closed). Likely ineligible (endogenous analyte, supplement product) if the full text confirms this.
